tasks.check: deno task --cwd sdk check && deno task --cwd runtime check && deno task --cwd desktop check && deno task --cwd cli check
tasks.lint: deno lint sdk runtime desktop cli
tasks.test: deno task --cwd sdk test && deno task --cwd runtime test && deno task --cwd desktop test && deno task --cwd cli test
tasks.verify:generated: deno task generate:api && deno fmt runtime/generated && git diff --exit-code -- runtime/generated
